tools.name: ping
tools.description: Check that the Aiko connection is reachable and authenticated for this workspace. Free.

tools.name: provisionOraclePackage
tools.description: Install the pinned npm package needed for a reported real-API oracle failure. Use only after Aiko names a missing oracle package.

surface.description: surface/module id, e.g. react-base-ui or react-radix

tools.name: getContext
tools.description: Get compact design-system context for one component and surface. Pass full=true for the complete contract payload. Free.

target.description: surface/module id or alias, e.g. react-radix or react

full.description: return the full context object instead of the compact agent packet

tools.name: listModules
tools.description: Every module/surface this workspace knows about — pre-built projection targets (react-base-ui, figma, ...) and real ingested sources alike — with its kind, origin, whether it's currently active (modules.yaml's activeModules), and its component coverage. Check this BEFORE passing a `targets` value to proposeIngestion: a target string that looks like a real surface (borrowed from an unrelated file, a Storybook fixture, etc.) is not validated against anything — declaring one that an ingested source already provides real contract coverage for is refused at apply time, but confirming it here first avoids the wasted round-trip. A `figma` entry is graph/ingestion metadata, NOT evidence that Aiko has a Figma Desktop plugin or can write to Figma: design-canvas writes require a separately configured Figma Console MCP with its Desktop Bridge connected to the target file. Free, no model call, engine-local only.

tools.name: getContextBundle
tools.description: Build compact patch context for one existing artifact edit. In hosted mode, include the canonical component in seedComponents and identify the changed part with startLine/endLine or symbol; Aiko will refuse an incomplete component scope rather than guess. Pass full=true for complete evidence. Free.

task.description: what the human wants changed, e.g. 'Make this Dialog slightly rounder.'

target.description: surface/module id, alias, or family, e.g. react-radix or react

artefact.description: affected file — a real path inside AIKO_LOCAL_REPO works in network modes (the bridge ships bounded content and a repository-relative locator, never the absolute path); relative-to-sourceRoot/source also works if you'd rather not resolve it locally

startLine.description: selection start line (1-based); use with endLine — one of this range or symbol is required for hosted component patches

endLine.description: selection end line (inclusive); use with startLine — one of this range or symbol is required for hosted component patches

symbol.description: alternative anchor: a symbol name inside the artefact; required for hosted component patches when no line range is available

seedComponents.description: canonical seed components, e.g. ['Dialog']; required for hosted component patches

concern.description: narrow concern enum: radius|spacing|colour token, component-replacement, prop-correction, copy-edit

sourceRoot.description: LOCAL mode: root path of the connected repo the artefact resolves against

source.description: registered design-system source name, when needed for token-conformance evidence

full.description: return the full Context Bundle instead of the compact agent packet

tools.name: verifyArtifact
tools.description: Verify current artifact content against Aiko contracts. Returns a compact report by default; pass full=true for the complete AikoReport. Free.

file.description: artifact path (absolute, or relative to aiko-graph/ in local mode)

locator.description: artifact path relative to the registered design-system source, if known

buildResult.description: result of a build run locally by the customer agent; never a command

full.description: return the full AikoReport instead of the compact report

tools.name: auditComponent
tools.description: Audit a file's current component conformance without an original/modified diff. Compact by default; pass full=true for all signals. Free.

file.description: artifact path (absolute, or relative to aiko-graph/ in local mode)

locator.description: artifact path relative to the registered design-system source, if known

buildResult.description: result of a build run locally by the customer agent; never a command

full.description: return the full AikoReport instead of the compact report

tools.name: verifyPatch
tools.description: Compare original and modified content against a Context Bundle. Compact by default; pass full=true for the complete report. Free.

bundleId.description: the Context Bundle id (ctx_…) from getContextBundle

original.description: the original artefact content or file path (tip: `git show HEAD:<file>` for the pre-patch content)

modified.description: the patched artefact content or file path

full.description: return the full trust report instead of the compact report

tools.name: reportDrift
tools.description: Emit the current drift report. Free.

tools.name: proposeIngestion
tools.description: Ingest one local component or token source into Aiko. In hosted mode, this also gathers the source's own direct local siblings (its imports resolved to real files, one hop) plus its nearest tsconfig/jsconfig and uploads them alongside it, so a composed component's real siblings can actually be detected — you do not need to ingest siblings first yourself. Aiko funds the model reconcile and creates a durable, reviewable delta. For cva/Tailwind sources, read `report.styleBindings` and `extractedEvidence.descriptor.styleBindings`: `styleEvidence.bindings` covers separate inline/CSS declaration evidence and cannot show whether utility-class bindings were extracted. A delta proposing nothing novel (no new canonical instance, nothing needing review) is applied automatically in this same call — check the response's `mutationUsed`/`validation.needsReview` to tell which happened. Anything proposing a genuinely new canonical instance stays a pending, unapplied delta requiring a separate, human-approved applyApprovedDelta call.

source.description: path to a component or token source inside AIKO_LOCAL_REPO

from.description: source adapter, e.g. css | dtcg | react-aria

figmaToken.description: Figma personal access token — required when `source` is a Figma file key/URL

forceNew.description: Deterministically ingest as its OWN new canonical component, even if the model would otherwise claim it reuses an existing one — use this for the 'no, these are different' outcome of an identity-uncertainty review (a cross-name-reuse or possible-duplicate claim from a prior propose), never as a default. Unlike policy: 'greenfield' (a prompt nudge the model can still ignore), this is enforced deterministically in code: any 'existing' claim the model makes is discarded, and the component's name is forced back to the incoming source's own name.

tools.name: validateIngestionDelta
tools.description: Validate a proposed aiko-ingestion-delta against schema, references, policy, and new-instance review gates. Free, non-mutating.

delta.description: path to the delta JSON, e.g. runs/ingestion/<id>.delta.json

allowNew.description: allow proposed new canonical instances (else they become needs_review)

tools.name: applyApprovedDelta
tools.description: Apply a validated, human-approved ingestion delta to the canonical graph. MUTATING — requires an approval file (approvedBy / approvedAt / approvalScope / allowedNewCanonicalInstances / allowedFiles); the engine refuses invalid or unapproved deltas, unapproved new instances, unapproved write files, and stale source hashes. Use only after validateIngestionDelta passes and a human approves.

delta.description: path to the validated delta JSON

approval.description: path to the approval JSON authorizing the write

tools.name: proposeCustomPart
tools.description: Manually declare an additional signal-checkable 'part' on an EXISTING component's EXISTING contract, so verifyPatch's preservation gate can track something ingest's automatic oracle grounding never confirmed — e.g. a polymorphic-render prop (asChild/Slot/useRender) with no declared part at all, or a declared requiredPart whose library-alias grounding failed. This bypasses oracle grounding, so `rationale` is required and audited; there is no auto-apply — every proposal needs a human-approved applyApprovedCustomPart. `signals` must be literal tokens with no whitespace (matched verbatim against patched file content), never prose.

module.description: module/surface id the component's contract lives under, e.g. mcp-aiko-observatory

part.description: new part name, e.g. asChild — must not collide with an existing requiredPart/optionalPart/customPart

signals.description: literal, whitespace-free tokens to match against patched file content, e.g. ['useRender']

kind.description: prop | export | class-hook | convention, or another short label — an open vocabulary, not enforced

rationale.description: required: why this part exists and why it can't be oracle-grounded — reviewed by a human before approval

tools.name: applyApprovedCustomPart
tools.description: Apply a human-approved customPart delta (from proposeCustomPart) to the component's contract. MUTATING — requires an approval file (approvedBy / approvalScope / expectedStateHash); the engine refuses an unapproved or stale delta. Use only after a human reviews the delta's rationale.

delta.description: path to the proposed delta JSON, e.g. runs/custom-parts/<id>.delta.json

approval.description: path to the approval JSON authorizing the write

tools.name: listProjectionSurfaces
tools.description: List destination code surfaces that this workspace can use for agent-assisted projection. Figma is returned only as an operator handoff: Aiko has no Figma Desktop plugin, so the separately configured Figma Console MCP Desktop Bridge must be connected to the target file. Free and read-only.

tools.name: recordVerifiedRealization
tools.description: After writing a projection locally, verify its stamped content and record its Aiko realization receipt. Requires a passing local build result; Aiko never writes to your repository.

locator.description: repository-relative artifact path; defaults to the supplied file's relative path

tools.name: recordRealization
tools.description: Persist provenance that an artifact realizes a canonical component on a surface (realizations/<surface>.<component>.json). Small write, no model call.

locator.description: artifact path or surface node id
